name: ELECTRO-HOBBY-3D-UPDATER
notes: Does not belong to HYDRA-UMC, URTC, A.R.M.O.R. or EH3D - it sits above all four, dispatching to whichever ecosystem's own updater the user picks via --ecosystem.
